data.name: Algie
data.gender_notes: Algie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Algia, meaning ‘other’ or ‘stranger’. It was used as a name for soldiers or travelers, reflecting their warrior spirit and foreign origins. In Christianity, Algie could be seen as a symbol of faith and loyalty, carrying the light of God to unfamiliar lands. The name Algie carries the meaning “Kind and loyal warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Algie usually hope their child will grow to embody kind and loyal warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name carrying the spirit of adventure and exploration, symbolizing the journey of faith and the courage to step into the unknown.
data.etymology: Algie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Kind and loyal warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Algie total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.meaning: משמעות שם עלגי: שם שמוצאו מערבית ומשמעותו כלומר 'אדוני'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם עלגי, בדומה לשמות נוצריים אחרים, נוצר כשם לאדם שמשפחתו ממוצא ערבי. השם נטבע עם השפעה נוצרית, ודבר זה באהדה בעיקר על ידי הכנסייה הקתולית. עם הזמן, השם נעשה נפוץ גם בעולם הנוצרי, ושם זה נותר קשור לתפיסות נוצריות. השם עלגי, בעצם, יכול לסמל חברות, אהבה ופיוס, כל זאת על רקע של נאמנות ואמונה.
